segments.name: transportation logistics
products: expedited ground and air delivery of time-critical freight
segments.description: Provides integrated transportation management solutions across truck, rail, air and ocean modes to a broad range of customers, primarily in North America.
segments.evidence: The transportation logistics segment provides a wide range of integrated transportation management solutions.

segments.name: insurance
products: property and casualty insurance and reinsurance
segments.description: Provides risk and claims management services to Landstar's Operating Subsidiaries and reinsures certain risks of BCO Independent Contractors.
segments.evidence: The insurance segment provides risk and claims management services to certain of Landstar's Operating Subsidiaries.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Landstar per shipment for the physical transportation of freight, and the insurance segment earns reinsurance premiums from third party insurance companies.
revenueModel.evidence: Billings for freight transportation services are typically charged to customers on a per shipment basis for the physical transportation of freight and are referred to as transportation revenue.
